result.finding: No explicit container CPU or memory resource limits configured in docker-compose.yml. The Java application self-limits JVM heap via JAVA_OPTS (-Xmx512m -Xms256m). README recommends minimum 4GB RAM for the Oracle DB container, but this is not enforced via resource constraints.
evidence: docker-compose.yml: no deploy.resources section in either service definition
Dockerfile ENV JAVA_OPTS=-Xmx512m -Xms256m (JVM heap: 256MB min, 512MB max — app-level limit, not container-level)
README.md: 'Minimum 4GB RAM available for Oracle DB container' (documentation only, not enforced)
No Kubernetes resource limits or requests (no k8s manifests present)
values: Recommended system RAM: 4GB+ (Oracle DB requirement, per README)
